officialTitle: Code Was Never the Hard Part. Understanding Was—and Still Is.

chapters.title: Introduction: code is cheap, understanding is not
Write: faster helpers and a larger scope for mistakes
Refactoring study: file correctness and repository risks
Read: understanding and the review bottleneck
Agent memory, tacit knowledge and decision context
Decide: when the next user is another agent
Design for replacement and own your data
Care: deterministic checks, human review and security
Three gates: safe, grounded and measured
Takeaways: measure the system and record the why

existingSummary: Muhammad Waseem argues that AI-generated code shifts the bottleneck toward understanding and ownership. He presents a refactoring study, discusses review load and missing decision context, and explores applications whose users are agents. He proposes deterministic and human checks, safe, grounded and measured gates, and recording why decisions are made.
